Submitted: WARRANTY flagged as a **deviation** at the fallback target.

- **Findings:** § 5.1 warrants only "reasonable care and skill" for Services with no period and no remedy; § 5.1(c)-equivalent conformance warranty for software/Materials is absent; § 5.2 makes 5.1 exclusive and § 5.4(c) puts all Materials and software "AS IS". No repair/replace/refund mechanic exists anywhere (searches for refund, conform, documentation, malicious code returned nothing).
- **Cure (shortest complete):** a new § 5.1(c) adding a 90-day software conformance-to-documentation warranty, an at-least-30-day duration for the existing Services warranty (phrased so it does not cap the current durationless promise), and repair/replacement, re-performance or refund; plus a six-word carve-out in § 5.4(c) so the AS IS disclaimer does not swallow the express warranties.
